description: Generic, problem-agnostic contract for mathematical-modeling workflows.

field_contract.entities: array of named entities; no domain-specific vocabulary is required
field_contract.inputs: array of objects with id, type, domain, unit, source
field_contract.state_functions: array of objects with id, arguments, output, definition_ref
field_contract.decision_variables: array of objects with id, type, domain, unit
field_contract.hard_constraints: array of machine-checkable constraints with id and expression_ref
field_contract.soft_constraints: array of constraints with id and penalty_ref
field_contract.evaluator: object with evaluator_id, implementation_ref, event_policy, aggregation
field_contract.uncertainty: object describing uncertainty handling or null applicability
field_contract.validation_contract: object defining invariant tests, tolerances, and required independent checks

rules: The contract is domain-neutral and must not encode a particular contest problem.
Every decision variable and hard constraint used by code must resolve to this contract.
Main, baseline, and verifier must declare the same objective and hard-constraint contract.
A missing or unresolved contract reference blocks downstream code generation.
